name: Open Zen Community
reason: No website or contact route of its own: the SZBA centre page (szba.org/open-zen-community, read 13 Nov 2026) gives only a name and an affiliated teacher (Hobu Beata Chapman), and two web searches (13 Nov 2026) found only a 2018 San Francisco Zen Center blog profile of it as a small lay Branching Streams sangha in the Bay Area, with no site of its own.
